Alex M: Hey people-ops — quick q: I enrolled in benefits during onboarding but haven't got my physical health card yet. Also wondering how deductions will show up on my first paycheck (started 2025-03-01). Is PTO prorated for new hires? Any forms I missed?

Jen (People Ops): Welcome, Alex! :party: Physical cards typically ship 7–10 business days after enrollment. Did you confirm your home address in Workday? Payroll deductions start the first pay period after the benefits effective date. For biweekly folks, that usually shows up on the paystub for the first payday after the coverage start. I'll pull your exact effective date in a sec.

Alex M: Address is correct in Workday. I'm on biweekly cadence — when is the first take-home approx, and is there a way to preview deduction amounts before getting the paystub?

Payroll Bot: Payroll schedule: biweekly on Fridays. Deductions are visible in Workday > Pay > Pay Statements once the payroll run posts. Example line items: "Medical - Employee" and "Dental - Employee" with per-pay-period withheld amounts (monthly premium/2 for biweekly typically).

Maria R: Hi Alex — I can check your enrollment record. Can you DM me your employee ID? PTO accrual policy: new hires accrue at 1.25 days/month (15 days/year) and accrual is prorated for partial months. Since you started 2025-03-01, you get the full March accrual. Company holidays: 10 fixed + 1 floating floating holiday.

Sam L: If you need the card sooner, call the insurer's member services and ask for an e-card or temporary ID. Have your RedWood plan code ready (email me if you want it). You can also download the insurer app and use the e-card immediately.

Alex M: Thanks. Also filed a reimbursement for desk setup (chairs/monitor stand) last Wed — any ETA on that?

Jen (People Ops): Reimbursements: People Ops triages within 3 business days, then Finance pays on the next AP run (Tues & Thurs). If you uploaded receipts to Expensify, tag them with "newhire-setup" to escalate. If you want, paste the Expensify link here or DM and I'll flag it.

Paul T: One more FYI — remote employees can opt into the WFH stipend ($75/month). It's set up in the Benefits portal under "Perks"; selecting it will show on your next payroll as a non-taxable stipend line (if applicable).

Alex M: Who should I ping to update my address if I move? Workday vs People Ops?

Maria R: Always update Workday Contact Info first. If it's urgent (card needs re-ship) DM me and we'll trigger a manual update/reship.

Alex M: Awesome, thanks all! :thumbsup:
